verification_level: FAST plus BATCH, with targeted ASan controls for M8-D1 and M8-D2
scope: mechanism-contract sweep over attribution ranks 85-92; evp/skeymgmt.rs and bn/bignum.rs each yielded one defect (fixed); the other six files audited clean; no file presented a new reusable unsafe boundary

defects.description: OwnedSkey::drop called evp_skeymgmt_freedata unconditionally; the authority's EVP_SKEY_free guards keydata != NULL. The import/generate failure paths free a key whose keydata was never produced, so a mandatory provider free(NULL) was invoked in a state the authority never invokes. A provider whose free dereferences its key data faults.
defects.fix: Restored the authority's keydata != NULL guard in Drop; updated the re-entrancy fixture to supply non-NULL key data and added a data-less-key destructor test.

defects.class: aliasing UB on a C-valid call
defects.description: BN_copy formed (as_mut(a), as_ref(b)) before testing identity. BN_copy(a, a) is valid in the authority and returns a early (bn_lib.c:341-342); the crate created aliasing borrows (UB) and cleared the destination before reading the source, emptying the number.
defects.fix: Added the authority's early return for a.cast_const() == b before any borrow is formed, and updated the safety contract.
